long_biography.plain_text:
Montana-born David M. Leuschen joined Goldman Sachs after completing his MBA at Dartmouth's Tuck School. He made energy his specialty, founded and led the firm's Global Energy and Power Group, and chaired its energy investment committee. In 2000 he and Pierre Lapeyre created Riverstone, combining sector expertise with private-equity capital to build companies across conventional energy, power, infrastructure and renewables.

At Riverstone, Leuschen sits on the investment committees of the firm's investment vehicles and remains a senior managing director as the platform broadens toward energy transition. His ties to the American West shaped another strand of work. He developed Switchback Ranch over several decades, focusing on regenerative agriculture, and later co-founded Riverstone Earth to invest in nature-based solutions. His conservation roles have included board service with Conservation International and Montana Land Reliance.
